items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: he had a friend, Marcus Korn... And they used to take me to the, uh, Pelican ball games.

ctx.x: But, uh, a lot of, a lot of good things happened to me. I don't know if this is germane or what we're doing. Oh yeah, it is. Yeah, yeah, yeah. I'll just ride along. That, that, that my father's insurance agent, uh, was, was, uh, named Hirsch. Uh-huh. Henry Hirsch, the Jewish guy. And he had a friend, Marcus Korn, another Jewish guy who owned a plumbing company, Marion Plumbing Company uptown. And they used to take me to the, uh, Pelican ball games. Oh.
